name: Moody's Growth & Strategy
description:
Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP supports AI-driven sales, marketing, and revenue operations by providing GenAI-ready data, analytics, and insights to inform go-to-market execution. It brings together firmographic, ownership, relationship, and market datasets into a unified intelligence layer to help teams identify opportunities, prioritize accounts, and support more effective customer engagement. 
 
The solution combines comprehensive Moody’s entity intelligence, including global company profiles, hierarchies, and ownership linkages, with augmented signals such as news, market activity, and risk indicators. This integrated view helps organizations gain additional visibility into total addressable markets, identify whitespace opportunities, and align sales and marketing strategies around high-value prospects. 
 
By bringing together structured company data and contextual insights into a single interface, Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP helps streamline data-to-insight workflows and supports improvements in targeting precision, pipeline quality, and revenue outcomes. 
 
Data includes: 
Global company firmographics and identifiers
Corporate hierarchies and ownership structures
Industry classifications and segmentation
Financial indicators and company scale metrics
News, market signals, and company events
Risk indicators and early warning signals
Economic data and research
 
Use Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP for:
GTM Planning – define and size target markets with comprehensive company coverage 
Account Prioritization – identify and prioritize high-value prospects and customers and support more sophisticated opportunity scoring by combining company-level data with market-level indicators.
Territory Design – support geographic and account planning by highlighting industries, regions or countries with stronger growth prospects
 
Pipeline Acceleration – surface in-market signals and help support timely engagement based on macroeconomic tren

_published_faq.name: How do I add Moody's Growth & Strategy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Moody's Growth & Strategy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.moodys.com/genai-ready-data/GrowthAndStrategy/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Moody's Growth & Strategy MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Moody's Growth & Strategy provides these MCP tools: findEntity, getEntityBeneficiaryOwners, getEntityFinancials_v2, getEntityManagersDirectors_v2, getEntityPeers, getEntityProfile, getEntitySegmentFinancials, getEntitySubsidiaries, getEntityUltimateOwners, searchCompanyFilings, searchEntityEarningsCall, and searchNews.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Moody's Growth & Strategy?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Moody's Growth & Strategy in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Moody's Growth & Strategy MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Moody's Growth & Strategy requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Moody's Growth & Strategy is developed by Moody's Analytics. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
